local wezterm = require('wezterm')
local platform = require('utils.platform')
-- local backdrops = require('utils.backdrops')
local act = wezterm.action

local mod = {}

if platform.is_mac then
    mod.SUPER = 'SUPER'
    mod.SUPER_REV = 'SUPER|CTRL'
elseif platform.is_win or platform.is_linux then
    mod.SUPER = 'ALT' -- to not conflict with Windows key shortcuts
    mod.SUPER_REV = 'CTRL'
end

-- stylua: ignore
local keys = {
   -- misc/useful --
   { key = 'phys:K', mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL', action = act.ClearScrollback('ScrollbackOnly') },
   { key = 'phys:X', mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL', action = 'ActivateCopyMode' },
   { key = 'phys:p', mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL', action = act.ActivateCommandPalette },
   { key = 'Space', mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL', action = act.ShowLauncher },
   { key = 'F4', mods = 'CTRL', action = act.ShowLauncherArgs({ flags = 'FUZZY|TABS' }) },
   {
      key = 'F5',
      mods = 'CTRL',
      action = act.ShowLauncherArgs({ flags = 'FUZZY|WORKSPACES' }),
   },
   { key = 'F11', mods = 'NONE',    action = act.ToggleFullScreen },
   { key = 'F12', mods = 'NONE',    action = act.ShowDebugOverlay },
   { key = 'f',   mods = mod.SUPER, action = act.Search({ CaseInSensitiveString = '' }) },
   {
      key = 'u',
      mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL',
      action = wezterm.action.QuickSelectArgs({
         label = 'open url',
         patterns = {
            '\\((https?://\\S+)\\)',
            '\\[(https?://\\S+)\\]',
            '\\{(https?://\\S+)\\}',
            '<(https?://\\S+)>',
            '\\bhttps?://\\S+[)/a-zA-Z0-9-]+'
         },
         action = wezterm.action_callback(function(window, pane)
            local url = window:get_selection_text_for_pane(pane)
            wezterm.log_info('opening: ' .. url)
            wezterm.open_with(url)
         end),
      }),
   },

   -- Tab navigation --
   { key = 'Tab',        mods = 'CTRL',        action = act.ActivateTabRelative(1) },
   { key = 'Tab',        mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL',  action = act.ActivateTabRelative(-1) },

   { key = '3',          mods = 'CTRL|ALT',    action = act.ActivateTab(2) },
   { key = '4',          mods = 'CTRL|ALT',    action = act.ActivateTab(3) },
   { key = '5',          mods = 'CTRL|ALT',    action = act.ActivateTab(4) },
   { key = '6',          mods = 'CTRL|ALT',    action = act.ActivateTab(5) },

   -- cursor movement --
   { key = 'LeftArrow',  mods = mod.SUPER,     action = act.SendString '\u{1b}OH' },
   { key = 'RightArrow', mods = mod.SUPER,     action = act.SendString '\u{1b}OF' },
   -- { key = 'Backspace',  mods = mod.SUPER,     action = act.SendString '\u{15}' },

   -- copy/paste --
   { key = 'c',          mods = 'CTRL|SHIFT',  action = act.CopyTo('Clipboard') },
   { key = 'Insert',     mods = 'CTRL',        action = act.CopyTo('Clipboard') },
   { key = 'v',          mods = 'CTRL|SHIFT',  action = act.PasteFrom('Clipboard') },
   { key = 'Insert',     mods = 'SHIFT',       action = act.PasteFrom('Clipboard') },

   -- tabs --

display.text:
local wezterm = require('wezterm')

local function is_found(str, pattern)
    return string.find(str, pattern) ~= nil
end

---@alias PlatformType 'windows' | 'linux' | 'mac'

---@return {os: PlatformType, is_win: boolean, is_linux: boolean, is_mac: boolean}
local function platform()
    local is_win = is_found(wezterm.target_triple, 'windows')
    local is_linux = is_found(wezterm.target_triple, 'linux')
    local is_mac = is_found(wezterm.target_triple, 'apple')
    local os

    if is_win then
        os = 'windows'
    elseif is_linux then
        os = 'linux'
    elseif is_mac then
        os = 'mac'
    else
        error('Unknown platform')
    end

    return {
        os = os,
        is_win = is_win,
        is_linux = is_linux,
        is_mac = is_mac,
    }
end

local _platform = platform()

return _platform

---@param max_width number
---@param inset number
local function create_title(process_name, base_title, max_width, inset)
    local title

    if process_name:len() > 0 then
        title = process_name .. ' ~ ' .. base_title
    else
        title = base_title
    end

    if base_title == 'Debug' then
        title = GLYPH_DEBUG .. ' DEBUG'
        inset = inset - 2
    end

    if base_title:match('^InputSelector:') ~= nil then
        title = base_title:gsub('InputSelector:', GLYPH_SEARCH)
        inset = inset - 2
    end

    if title:len() > max_width - inset then
        local diff = title:len() - max_width + inset
        title = title:sub(1, title:len() - diff)
    else
        local padding = max_width - title:len() - inset
        title = title .. string.rep(' ', padding)
    end

    return title
end

---@param panes any[] WezTerm https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/config/lua/pane/index.html
local function check_unseen_output(panes)
    local unseen_output = false
    local unseen_output_count = 0

    for i = 1, #panes, 1 do
        if panes[i].has_unseen_output then
            unseen_output = true
            if unseen_output_count >= 10 then
                unseen_output_count = 10
                break
            end
            unseen_output_count = unseen_output_count + 1
        end
    end

    return unseen_output, unseen_output_count
end

---
-- =================
-- Tab class and API
-- =================

---@class Tab
---@field title string
---@field cells Cells
---@field title_locked boolean
---@field locked_title string
---@field is_wsl boolean
---@field is_admin boolean
---@field unseen_output boolean
---@field unseen_output_count number
---@field is_active boolean
local Tab = {}
Tab.__index = Tab

function Tab:new()
    local tab = {
        title = '',
        cells = Cells:new(),
        title_locked = false,
        locked_title = '',
        is_wsl = false,
        is_admin = false,
        unseen_output = false,
        unseen_output_count = 0,
    }
    return setmetatable(tab, self)
end

---@param event_opts Event.TabTitleOptions
---@param tab any WezTerm https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/config/lua/MuxTab/index.html
---@param max_width number
function Tab:set_info(event_opts, tab, max_width)
    local process_name = clean_process_name(tab.active_pane.foreground_process_name)

    self.is_wsl = process_name:match('^wsl') ~= nil
    self.is_admin = (tab.active_pane.title:match('^Administrator: ') or tab.active_pane.title:match('(Admin)')) ~= nil
    self.unseen_output = false
    self.unseen_output_count = 0

    if not event_opts.hide_active_tab_unseen or not tab.is_active then
        self.unseen_output, self.unseen_output_count = check_unseen_output(tab.panes)
    end

    local inset = (self.is_admin or self.is_wsl) and TITLE_INSET.ICON or TITLE_INSET.DEFAULT
    if self.unseen_output then
        inset = inset + 2
    end

    if self.title_locked then
        self.title = create_title('', self.locked_title, max_width, inset)
        return
    end
    self.title = create_title(process_name, tab.active_pane.title, max_width, inset)
end

function Tab:create_cells()
    local attr = self.cells.attr
    self.cells
        :add_segment('scircle_left', GLYPH_SCIRCLE_LEFT)
        :add_segment('admin', ' ' .. GLYPH_ADMIN)
        :add_segment('wsl', ' ' .. GLYPH_LINUX)
        :add_segment('title', ' ', nil, attr(attr.intensity('Bold')))
        :add_segment('unseen_output', ' ' .. GLYPH_CIRCLE)
        :add_segment('padding', ' ')
        :add_segment('scircle_right', GLYPH_SCIRCLE_RIGHT)
end

---@param title string
function Tab:update_and_lock_title(title)
    self.locked_title = title
    self.title_locked = true
end

---@param event_opts Event.TabTitleOptions
---@param is_active boolean
---@param hover boolean
function Tab:update_cells(event_opts, is_active, hover)
    local tab_state = 'default'
    if is_active then
        tab_state = 'active'
    elseif hover then
        tab_state = 'hover'
    end

    self.cells:update_segment_text('title', ' ' .. self.title)

    if event_opts.unseen_icon == 'numbered_box' and self.unseen_output then
        self.cells:update_segment_text('unseen_output', ' ' .. GLYPH_UNSEEN_NUMBERED_BOX[self.unseen_output_count])
    end
    if event_opts.unseen_icon == 'numbered_circle' and self.unseen_output then
        self.cells:update_segment_text('unseen_output', ' ' .. GLYPH_UNSEEN_NUMBERED_CIRCLE[self.unseen_output_count])
    end

    self.cells
        :update_segment_colors('scircle_left', colors['scircle_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('admin', colors['text_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('wsl', colors['text_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('title', colors['text_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('unseen_output', colors['unseen_output_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('padding', colors['text_' .. tab_state])
        :update_segment_colors('scircle_right', colors['scircle_' .. tab_state])
end

---@return FormatItem[] (ref: https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/config/lua/wezterm/format.html)
function Tab:render()
    local variant_idx = self.is_admin and 3 or 1
    if self.is_wsl then
        variant_idx = 5
    end

    if self.unseen_output then
        variant_idx = variant_idx + 1
    end
    return self.cells:render(RENDER_VARIANTS[variant_idx])
end

---@type Tab[]
local tab_list = {}

---@param opts? Event.TabTitleOptions Default: {unseen_icon = 'circle', hide_active_tab_unseen = true}
M.setup = function(opts)
    local valid_opts, err = EVENT_OPTS.validator:validate(opts or {})

    if err then
        wezterm.log_error(err)
    end

    -- CUSTOM EVENT
    -- Event listener to manually update the tab name
    -- Tab name will remain locked until the `reset-tab-title` is triggered
    wezterm.on('tabs.manual-update-tab-title', function(window, pane)
        window:perform_action(
            wezterm.action.PromptInputLine({
                description = wezterm.format({
                    { Foreground = { Color = '#FFFFFF' } },
                    { Attribute = { Intensity = 'Bold' } },
                    { Text = 'Enter new name for tab' },
                }),
                action = wezterm.action_callback(function(_window, _pane, line)
                    if line ~= nil then
                        local tab = window:active_tab()
                        local id = tab:tab_id()
                        tab_list[id]:update_and_lock_title(line)
                    end
                end),
            }),
            pane
        )
    end)

    -- CUSTOM EVENT
    -- Event listener to unlock manually set tab name
    wezterm.on('tabs.reset-tab-title', function(window, _pane)
        local tab = window:active_tab()
        local id = tab:tab_id()
        tab_list[id].title_locked = false
    end)

    -- CUSTOM EVENT
    -- Event listener to manually update the tab name
    wezterm.on('tabs.toggle-tab-bar', function(window, _pane)
        local effective_config = window:effective_config()
        window:set_config_overrides({
            enable_tab_bar = not effective_config.enable_tab_bar,
            background = effective_config.background,
        })
    end)

    -- BUILTIN EVENT
    wezterm.on('format-tab-title', function(tab, _tabs, _panes, _config, hover, max_width)
        if not tab_list[tab.tab_id] then
            tab_list[tab.tab_id] = Tab:new()
            tab_list[tab.tab_id]:set_info(valid_opts, tab, max_width)
            tab_list[tab.tab_id]:create_cells()
            return tab_list[tab.tab_id]:render()
        end

        tab_list[tab.tab_id]:set_info(valid_opts, tab, max_width)
        tab_list[tab.tab_id]:update_cells(valid_opts, tab.is_active, hover)
        return tab_list[tab.tab_id]:render()
    end)
end

return M

local wezterm = require('wezterm')
local launch_menu = require('config.launch').launch_menu
local domains = require('config.domains')
local Cells = require('utils.cells')

local nf = wezterm.nerdfonts
local act = wezterm.action
local attr = Cells.attr

local M = {}

---@type table<string, Cells.SegmentColors>
-- stylua: ignore
local colors = {
   label_text   = { fg = '#CDD6F4' },
   icon_default = { fg = '#89B4FA' },
   icon_wsl     = { fg = '#FAB387' },
   icon_ssh     = { fg = '#F38BA8' },
   icon_unix    = { fg = '#CBA6F7' },
}

local cells = Cells:new()
    :add_segment('icon_default', ' ' .. nf.md_domain .. ' ', colors.icon_default)
    :add_segment('icon_wsl', ' ' .. nf.cod_terminal_linux .. ' ', colors.icon_wsl)
    :add_segment('icon_ssh', ' ' .. nf.md_ssh .. ' ', colors.icon_ssh)
    :add_segment('icon_unix', ' ' .. nf.dev_gnu .. ' ', colors.icon_unix)
    :add_segment('label_text', '', colors.label_text, attr(attr.intensity('Bold')))

local function build_choices()
    local choices = {}
    local choices_data = {}
    local idx = 1

    -- Add launch menu items (DefaultDomain)
    for _, v in ipairs(launch_menu) do
        cells:update_segment_text('label_text', v.label)

        table.insert(choices, {
            id = tostring(idx),
            label = wezterm.format(cells:render({ 'icon_default', 'label_text' })),
        })
        table.insert(choices_data, {
            args = v.args,
            domain = 'DefaultDomain',
        })
        idx = idx + 1
    end

    -- Add WSL domains
    for _, v in ipairs(domains.wsl_domains) do
        cells:update_segment_text('label_text', v.name)

        table.insert(choices, {
            id = tostring(idx),
            label = wezterm.format(cells:render({ 'icon_wsl', 'label_text' })),
        })
        table.insert(choices_data, {
            domain = { DomainName = v.name },
        })
        idx = idx + 1
    end

    -- Add SSH domains
    for _, v in ipairs(domains.ssh_domains) do
        cells:update_segment_text('label_text', v.name)
        table.insert(choices, {
            id = tostring(idx),
            label = wezterm.format(cells:render({ 'icon_ssh', 'label_text' })),
        })
        table.insert(choices_data, {
            domain = { DomainName = v.name },
        })
        idx = idx + 1
    end

    -- Add Unix domains
    for _, v in ipairs(domains.unix_domains) do
        cells:update_segment_text('label_text', v.name)
        table.insert(choices, {
            id = tostring(idx),
            label = wezterm.format(cells:render({ 'icon_unix', 'label_text' })),
        })
        table.insert(choices_data, {
            domain = { DomainName = v.name },
        })
        idx = idx + 1
    end

    return choices, choices_data
end

local choices, choices_data = build_choices()

M.setup = function()
    wezterm.on('new-tab-button-click', function(window, pane, button, default_action)
        if default_action and button == 'Left' then
            window:perform_action(default_action, pane)
        end

        if default_action and button == 'Right' then
            window:perform_action(
                act.InputSelector({
                    title = 'InputSelector: Launch Menu',
                    choices = choices,
                    fuzzy = true,
                    fuzzy_description = nf.md_rocket .. ' Select a lauch item: ',
                    action = wezterm.action_callback(function(_window, _pane, id, label)
                        if not id and not label then
                            return
                        else
                            wezterm.log_info('you selected ', id, label)
                            wezterm.log_info(choices_data[tonumber(id)])
                            window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab(choices_data[tonumber(id)]), pane)
                        end
                    end),
                }),
                pane
            )
        end
        return false
    end)
end

return M

Configuring Key Assignments
The default key table assignments can be overridden or extended using the keys section in your ~/.wezterm.lua config file. For example, you can disable a default assignment like this:
config.keys = {
-- Turn off the default CMD-m Hide action, allowing CMD-m to
-- be potentially recognized and handled by the tab
{
key = 'm',
mods = 'CMD',
action = wezterm.action.DisableDefaultAssignment,
},
}
The action value can be one of the available key assignments. Every action has an example that shows how to use it.
Possible Modifier labels are:
* SUPER, CMD, WIN - these are all equivalent: on macOS the Command key, on Windows the Windows key, on Linux this can also be the Super or Hyper key. Left and right are equivalent.
* CTRL - The control key. Left and right are equivalent.
* SHIFT - The shift key. Left and right are equivalent.
* ALT, OPT, META - these are all equivalent: on macOS the Option key, on other systems the Alt or Meta key. Left and right are equivalent.
* LEADER - a special modal modifier state managed by wezterm. See Leader Key for more information.
* VoidSymbol - This keycode is emitted in special cases where the original function of the key has been removed.
Such as in Linux and using setxkbmap. setxkbmap -option caps:none. The CapsLock will no longer function as before in all applications, instead emitting VoidSymbol.
You can combine modifiers using the | symbol (eg: "CMD|CTRL").
The key value can be one of the following keycode identifiers. Note that not all of these are meaningful on all platforms:
If you omit an explicit prefix, wezterm will assume phys: and use the physical position of the specified key.
The default key assignments listed above use phys:. In previous releases there was no physical position support and those assignments were all mapped:.
In some cases, wezterm may not know how to represent a key event in either its phys: or mapped: forms. In that case, you may wish to define an assignment in terms of the underlying operating system key code, using a raw: prefix.
Similar in concept to the phys: mapping described above, the raw: mapping is independent of the OS keyboard layout.
config.keys = {
{
key = '|',
mods = 'LEADER|SHIFT',
action = wezterm.action.SplitHorizontal { domain = 'CurrentPaneDomain' },
},
-- Send "CTRL-A" to the terminal when pressing CTRL-A, CTRL-A
{
key = 'a',
mods = 'LEADER|CTRL',
action = wezterm.action.SendKey { key = 'a', mods = 'CTRL' },
},
}
config.leader = { key = 'VoidSymbol', mods = '', timeout_milliseconds = 1000 }
config.keys = {
{
key = '|',
mods = 'LEADER|SHIFT',
action = wezterm.action.SplitHorizontal { domain = 'CurrentPaneDomain' },
},

KeyAssignment enumeration ¶
A KeyAssignment represents a pre-defined function that can be applied to control the Window, Tab, Pane state typically when a key or mouse event is triggered.
Internally, in the underlying Rust code, KeyAssignment is an enum type with a variant for each possible action known to wezterm.
In Lua, enums get represented as a table with a single key corresponding to the variant name.
In most cases the wezterm.action function is used to create an instance of KeyAssignment and make it a bit more clear and convenient."

function of the key has been removed. Such as in Linux and using `setxkbmap` . `setxkbmap -option caps:none` . The `CapsLock` will no longer function as
before in all applications, instead emitting `VoidSymbol` .

parts.text:
The `strings` output didn't reveal `default_keys` (binary uses merged string blobs). I'll rely on docs: `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` and `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()` exist (wezterm.gui module, requires version 20221119+; installed is 20261010). But note `wezterm.gui` is nil in headless contexts — in config loading for GUI it's available. Guard with `if wezterm.gui then`.

Important caveat: for the help, using `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` gives defaults for the current build. Alternatively use the more robust approach: parse `wezterm show-keys --lua` output? No, direct API is cleaner.

However — is there a risk that `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` doesn't exist in this build (nightly dev version 20261010)? It's a dev build; API exists since 2022. Should be fine. But I want a plan-level fallback: if API unavailable, fall back to parsing `docs/default-keys.md`? Better fallback: `io.popen('wezterm --skip-config show-keys --lua')` — heavy. Simpler: wrap in pcall and degrade gracefully.

Also: does `default_keys()` include `mods` normalization (SUPER vs ALT)? It returns the built-in defaults as configured internally: keys with mods 'CTRL|SHIFT' etc, key names with 'phys:' prefix? Let me check via docs markdown. Let me fetch raw markdown for default_keys.md and default_key_tables.md from GitHub (small files).

Also, since the config's own bindings are in `config/bindings.lua` (a pure table), we can require it directly from help.lua instead of `window:effective_config()` — that also makes help work outside the debug overlay. But careful: requiring config.bindings from utils.help creates a cycle? bindings requires utils.platform only; help requires bindings — no cycle. And wezterm.lua requires both. Fine.

Note: help.lua is currently required by wezterm.lua and installs `_G._keys` which uses global `window` (debug overlay only). New design: make help.lua a module `M` with:
- `M.render(opts)` → returns text (pure, testable)
- `M.action` → wezterm.action_callback that opens help in a new tab via pager
- `_G._keys` kept for F12 overlay (back-compat per AGENTS.md), now printing merged list.

Display mechanism details:
- Write text to a temp file: `wezterm.config_dir .. '/.cache/keys-help.txt'`? Does the repo have a .gitignore? Yes, .gitignore exists (15 bytes). Let me check its content. Writing into the config dir creates untracked junk; better to use `os.getenv('TMPDIR') or '/tmp'` via `os.tmpname()`. But `os.tmpname()` creates the file immediately — fine.
- Then `act.SpawnCommandInNewTab` with `program = 'less'`, args `{'-R', '--quit-if-one-screen', '-N', path}` — hmm `--quit-if-one-screen` might be undesirable for a long list; keep it (list is long, so it won't quit). Actually on short screens it won't fit anyway. I'd use plain `less -R`.
- Cross-platform pager: on Windows `more` has issues with UTF-8; could use `powershell -c Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8`... Let me check platform switch: `platform.is_win` → use `powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 <path>"` (no pager, just prints, tab closes at end with CloseOnCleanExit... actually the shell stays until process exits, then pane closes due to exit_behavior). Reasonable.

Alternative display without external programs: use `pane:send_text()` into a fresh tab. Let's consider: spawn tab with default_prog (shell), then `pane:send_text({text, '\x04'})`? send_text with bracketed paste issues; sending Ctrl-D is doable via `pane:send_text('\x04')`. Output would show text then shell returns to prompt. It's hacky; text would be echoed weirdly. Prefer pager approach with fallback.

Another neat option: `wezterm.action_callback` + `window:perform_action(act.Search ...)`. No.

Additional feature idea: also bind help to `F1` and `LEADER + ?` (i.e. key '?' with mods LEADER), plus keep it accessible via command palette (`ActivateCommandPalette` lists commands registered via `wezterm.action_callback`? Only those registered in the command palette... Actually the command palette lists standard commands; custom keybindings don't appear. Hmm, actually the command palette in wezterm lists "commands" from `wezterm.action` — no. There is `wezterm.emit`... The command palette does include key bindings? In wezterm, the command palette shows a fixed list of commands plus any `wezterm.action_callback` assigned to a key? Let me recall: wezterm's command palette is populated from the `commands` config key? In newer wezterm versions, key bindings with `action_callback` are... I believe the command palette includes entries defined by `config.command_palette`? Not existing. Skip.

Also there's `ShowLauncherArgs{flags='KEY_ASSIGNMENTS'}` (CTRL+F4 in config) which shows fuzzy list of all key assignments — a built-in help! Good to mention in the help output as a tip.

Now about "включая стандартные комбинации и изменённые в конфиге" — plan:
- Section per category, two subsections: "Активные (свои)" from config, and "Стандартные WezTerm (отключены: disable_default_key_bindings = true)" merged with override detection: if a (mods,key) pair exists in both, show config's action and mark `← переопределено`.
- Mark badges: `*` = из конфига, ` ` = стандартное, `x` = отключено.

Categories: reuse the group taxonomy from `docs/tempNotes.md` (Интерфейс, Окна и вкладки, Панели, Ввод/Копирование, История/Скролл, Поиск и выделение, Мышь, Клавиатурные таблицы (key tables), Прочее).

Now — questions for the user. Key decisions:
1. Which chord(s) to bind for help? (F1 / `?` with SHIFT+CTRL / LEADER+? / CTRL+SHIFT+/ etc.)
2. Where to show: new tab with less (scrollable) vs. current pane via InputSelector fuzzy vs. both.
3. Include standard wezterm defaults (~220 bindings) even though disabled — separate section? (I'm fairly confident yes, since they asked explicitly; but worth confirming how to mark them.)
4. Should `_keys()` in F12 remain and be aligned with the new list?

Let me also check .gitignore and whether `stylua`/`luacheck` are usable for verification (they are installed). Also check the CI workflow (.github) to see what's run.

Then I'll ask the user 2-4 questions and writethe plan.

Also: does the user want descriptions in Russian (consistent with existing help.lua)? Yes, existing style is Russian. I'll assume Russian and mention it.

Now write the plan. Let me detail implementation.

Files:
1. `utils/help.lua` — rewrite/extend into a module `M` with:
   - `M.render(opts?)` → string (full categorized help)
   - `M.show_pager_action` / `M.action` → `wezterm.action_callback` writing text to temp file and spawning a tab with pager
   - `M.picker_action` → InputSelector fuzzy over chords; selection copies chord to clipboard (and logs)
   - `_G._keys` retained (F12 overlay), now uses same renderer
   - `M.categories`/`M.actionDescriptions` table with Russian descriptions, extended for standard actions: CopyMode, Multiple, ReloadConfiguration, Hide, HideApplication, Show, CharSelect, IncreaseFontSize, DecreaseFontSize, ResetFontSize, ResetFontAndWindowSize, MoveTabRelative, MoveTab, AdjustPaneSize, QuickSelect, PaneSelect, CompleteSelection*, SelectTextAtMouseCursor, ExtendSelectionToMouseCursor, ScrollToTop/Bottom/Prompt, StartWindowDrag, SwitchToWorkspace, QuitApplication, Nop, SendKey, ClearSelection, ClearKeyTableStack, DisableDefaultAssignment, ActivateLastTab, ActivateWindow*, AttachDomain, DetachDomain, Copy/Paste, PastePrimarySelection, RotatePanes, SetPaneZoomState, ToggleAlwaysOnTop/Bottom, ShowTabNavigator, SpawnCommandInNewTab/Window, SplitPane, InputSelector, PromptInputLine, ResetTerminal, SetWindowLevel.
   - Data sources: `require('config.bindings')` (keys, key_tables, leader, disable_default_key_bindings), `wezterm.gui.default_keys()`, `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()`, `require('config.bindings').mouse_bindings` + `wezterm.gui.default_mouse_bindings()`? Is there `wezterm.gui.default_mouse_bindings()`? Docs list only default_key_tables and default_keys under wezterm.gui. So default mouse bindings would need fallback: parse? Better: read mouse bindings from `window:effective_config().mouse_bindings` when available (inside action callback we have `window`), else fall back to a curated hardcoded default list from docs/default-keys.md. Simpler: for mouse, use effective_config when available; note in the plan.

   Actually cleanest for the pager action: `wezterm.action_callback(function(window, pane) ... window:effective_config() ...)` gives merged keys/mouse_bindings/key_tables for the current window (accounts for set_config_overrides like tab-bar toggle). But `disable_default_key_bindings=true` means effective keys only contain config keys — good, we merge defaults from `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` ourselves. When called outside a window context (e.g., from `_keys()` in F12 REPL, `window` global exists), fallback to `require('config.bindings')`.

2. `config/bindings.lua` — add:
   - `{ key = 'F1', mods = 'NONE', action = Help.pager_action }` (or EmitEvent('help.show-pager') to keep deps clean)
   - `{ key = '?', mods = 'LEADER', action = Help.picker_action }`
   Following AGENTS.md convention: events in `events/`, but help is a util returning actions; the repo already requires utils.help in wezterm.lua. Cleanest: keep the actions in `utils/help.lua` (`M.actions.pager`, `M.actions.picker`) and bind them in `config/bindings.lua` via `require('utils.help').actions.pager`. Careful about circular require: help requires config.bindings for the static list, and bindings requires help → cycle! Avoid: help.lua must NOT require config.bindings at module load, OR bindings uses `wezterm.emit('help.show')` custom events registered by help.lua (no require back), or help.lua requires config.bindings lazily inside function bodies (Lua require cache: config.bindings loads utils.help at its load; help's require('config.bindings') inside a function executes at call time, after both loaded — that works).

   Prefer: use custom events (`help.show-pager`, `help.show-picker`) emitted from bindings, registered in help.lua via `wezterm.on` — matches the repo's existing pattern (tab-title.lua defines events consumed by bindings.lua), avoids cycles, keeps bindings.lua pure data-ish. But note `events/*` are the ones with `setup(opts)`; help.lua is a util without setup. AGENTS.md says utils/help.lua registers global `_keys` and requires in wezterm.lua. Registering `wezterm.on(...)` handlers at require-time in help.lua works (wezterm.on can be called during config load).

   Hmm — but which is more idiomatic? AGENTS.md hidden-coupling note says tab-title defines events consumed by bindings. I'll go with events, and mention it in the plan. Actually simpler & more discoverable: direct require in bindings.lua + lazy require in help.lua. Both work; events avoid the cycle question entirely. I'll propose events (with fallback note).

3. `wezterm.lua` — no change needed if help.lua self-registers on require (already `require('utils.help')`). Maybe add `require('utils.help')` unchanged. Good — no change.

4. Optional: `docs/keys-help.md` snapshot? Not required. Maybe add `readme.md` note. Keep optional.

Details of rendering:
- Header: wezterm version (`wezterm.version`? there's `wezterm.version` string), config file path, generated timestamp (`wezterm.time.now()`), note about disable_default_key_bindings.
- Legend: `*` свои/из конфига, `-` стандартные (не активны), `→` переопределено конфигом.
- Sections/categories (Russian): Интерфейс и панели, Окна и вкладки, Панели (сплиты), Копирование и ввод, Скролл и буфер, Поиск и выделение, Мышь, Клавиатурные таблицы (copy_mode, search_mode, resize_font, resize_pane) + LEADER chord summary.
- Sorted deterministically (mods then key) for stable diffing; column alignment (reuse `cpad`/`format_shortcut` helpers already in help.lua).
- Mods normalization for display: `SUPER` → `ALT` on Linux/Windows, `SUPER|CTRL` → `CTRL` (since mod.SUPER/SUPER_REV), and `phys:` prefix stripped but noted.

Pager action implementation:
```lua
local path = os.tmpname()  -- or wezterm.config_dir .. '/.cache/keys-help.txt'
local f = assert(io.open(path, 'w')); f:write(text); f:close()
local program, args
if platform.is_win then program = 'powershell.exe'; args = { '-NoProfile', '-Command', 'Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "' .. path .. '"' }
else program = 'less'; args = { '-R', '-X', path } end
window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab({ program = program, args = args }), pane)
```
Wait — `SpawnCommandInNewTab` args go through shell? No, they're exec'd directly (no shell) — that's fine; powershell.exe resolves via PATH. Fallback if spawn fails: print to pane via `pane:send_text(text)`.

Also delete temp file on exit? Not critical; but consider writing into `wezterm.config_dir` and gitignoring, or use `os.tmpname()` in /tmp (auto-cleaned by OS). I'll use `os.tmpname()`.

Picker action:
```lua
act.InputSelector{ title = 'Keybindings', fuzzy = true, fuzzy_description = 'Поиск по сочетаниям: ',
  choices = { { id, description = format_shortcut(...) } }, action = callback → copy chord to Clipboard via wezterm.clipboard / window:toast_notification }
```
Use `wezterm.clipboard.set(text)` or `window:perform_action(act.CopyTo('Clipboard'))`? For copying arbitrary text: `wezterm.clipboard.set(text)` exists (docs `wezterm.clipboard` module). Guard with pcall. Plus toast notification `window:toast_notification('WezTerm', msg, nil, 3000)`.

Verification steps:
- `luacheck .` and `stylua --check .` (both installed; CI uses them).
- `wezterm --config-file ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua show-keys --lua | rg 'F1|LEADER'` to confirm new bindings.
- Also add a pure-Lua smoke test outside wezterm? Can't easily (help.lua requires wezterm). Could test render logic by stubbing: `lua5.4 -e "package.path=...; local wezterm=setmetatable({...},{__index=function() return function() end end})"`. Hmm, lua is 5.1 (`/usr/bin/lua` → check version). Possible but optional; mention as optional manual check: `wezterm --config-file wezterm.lua show-keys` triggers config load → errors would surface; also F12 overlay `_keys()`.

Note AGENTS.md needs an update: add new key bindings info + note about help events. And the stale claims (no stylua.toml — there IS one; there IS luacheck CI; uncommitted edit note). Ask? I'll include a small AGENTS.md touch-up as optional step.

Also note: `mods = 'NONE'` used for F11/F12 in existing config. Follow suit.

Potential conflict check for F1: config has no F1. Standard defaults don't bind F1 either (not in show-keys list) — but defaults are disabled anyway. LEADER+? : no conflict.

## План: встроенная справка по горячим клавишам

### Что выяснил (важно для реализации)
- `config/bindings.lua:268` — `disable_default_key_bindings = true`, т.е. активны **только** ~40 сочетаний из конфига; стандартные ~220 выключены. Их надо брать отдельно.
- API для стандартных клавиш: `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` и `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()` (модуль `wezterm.gui`, есть с2022; установлен `wezterm 20261010`). **`wezterm.default_key_assignments()` не существует** — использовать нельзя.
- `utils/help.lua` уже умеет рендерить категории с русскими описаниями, но: (1) берёт только `window:effective_config().keys` (только кастомные), (2) не умеет ни key_tables, ни стандартные, ни мышь, (4) доступна только через F12-оверлей (глобальный `window`).
- Есть готовая таксономия категорий в `docs/tempNotes.md` (7 групп по `KeyAssignment`).
- Проверка: в репо есть CI (`stylua --check .` + `luacheck .`), обе утилиты установлены локально. `AGENTS.md` тут врёт (stylua.toml есть, luacheck есть) — поправлю попутно, если скажете.
- Реальный конфиг корректно грузится: `wezterm --config-file ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua show-keys` работает (проверил, 207 строк).

### Шаги

**1. `utils/help.lua` — переработать в модуль (сохранив `_G._keys` для F12)**
- `M.render(opts)` → строка-справка (чистая функция, без побочных эффектов).
- Источники данных:
  - свои: `require('config.bindings')` → `keys`, `key_tables`, `leader`, `disable_default_key_bindings`;
  - стандартные: `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` + `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()` (под `if wezterm.gui then`, иначе degrade gracefully);
  - мышь: `mouse_bindings` конфига + дефолтные (через `window:effective_config()` внутри action-callback, иначе только кастомные).
- Разделы: `Интерфейс`, `Окна и вкладки`, `Панели`, `Копирование и ввод`, `Скролл и буфер`, `Поиск и выделение`, `Мышь`, `Клавиатурные таблицы` (copy_mode, search_mode, resize_font, resize_pane) + строка с LEADER-последовательностями (`CTRL+Space`, таймаут 1 с).
- Легенда: `*` — из конфига, `-` — стандартное (не активно), `→` — перекрыто конфигом; нормировка модов под платформу (`SUPER`→`ALT`, `SUPER|CTRL`→`CTRL`), скрытие `phys:`.
- Дополнить `actionDesctiptions` описаниями для стандартных экшенов, которых сейчас нет: `CopyMode`, `Multiple`, `ReloadConfiguration`, `Hide/HideApplication`, `CharSelect`, `Increase/Decrease/ResetFontSize`, `MoveTabRelative`, `AdjustPaneSize`, `QuickSelect`, `PaneSelect`, `SelectTextAtMouseCursor`, `ScrollToTop/Bottom/Prompt`, `StartWindowDrag`, `SwitchToWorkspace`, `ActivateLastTab/Window*`, `SpawnCommandInNew*`, `ResetTerminal`, `QuitApplication` и т.д. (описания — русские, как сейчас).
- В шапке: версия wezterm, путь к конфигу, дата, предупреждение «стандартные клавиши отключены».
- Сохранить обратную совместимость: `_G._keys()` печатает теперь тот же merged-текст (иначе сломается единственный текущий способ вызова).

**2. Два действия + биндинги**
- `M.actions.pager` — `wezterm.action_callback`: рендерит текст → пишет в `os.tmpname()` → открывает **новую вкладку** с пайпером (`less -R -X <file>`; на Windows — `powershell Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8`, фолбэк — `pane:send_text(text)`).
- `M.actions.picker` — `InputSelector` с fuzzy-поиском по всем сочетаниям; выбор копирует сочетание в clipboard (`wezterm.clipboard.set`) + `window:toast_notification`.
- Регистрация как кастомные события `help.show-pager` / `help.show-picker` (паттерн `events/tab-title.lua` → `config/bindings.lua`), чтобы не было циклического `require` (`bindings` → `help` → `bindings`); `wezterm.lua` менять не нужно.
- В `config/bindings.lua` в секцию `misc/useful`: `F1`/`NONE` → `help.show-pager`, `?`/`LEADER` → `help.show-picker`.

**3. Проверка**
- `stylua --check .` и `luacheck .` (то же, что в CI).
- `wezterm --config-file ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua show-keys --lua | rg 'F1|LEADER'` — новые сочетания видны, конфиг грузится без ошибок.
- Живая проверка в GUI: F1 (вкладка со списком, `q` закрывает), `CTRL+Space ?`, F12 → `_keys()`.

**4. Опционально**
- Поправить `AGENTS.md`: добавить новые события в раздел «Hidden coupling», отметить наличие `stylua.toml`/luacheck-CI (сейчас там написано обратное).
- Сгенерировать снапшот `docs/keys-help.md` из того же рендерера.

Согласны с планом? Если да — уточните только: (а) попутно править `AGENTS.md`/добавлять `docs/keys-help.md`, (2) путь вывода — только `less` или с фолбэком на вывод прямо в панель?

Index: AGENTS.md
===================================================================
--- AGENTS.md	
+++ AGENTS.md	
@@ -1,125 +1,189 @@
 # AGENTS.md
 
 Personal wezterm configuration repo (Lua). Lives at `~/.config/wezterm/` and is
 versioned as a git repo (`origin` → `git@github.com:lukashevich-t/wezterm-config.git`).
 
 ## Architecture
 
 `wezterm.lua` is the **only** entry point wezterm auto-discovers. It:
 
 1. Builds a `Config` object via `config/init.lua` (small OO wrapper with `init()` + `append(tbl)` that dedupes keys with a `wezterm.log_warn`).
 2. Calls `setup()` on every event module under `events/`.
 3. Returns the merged options table built by `:append(require('config.*'))`.
 
 ```
 wezterm.lua                 ← entrypoint
 ├── config/                 ← pure option tables returned by each file
 │   ├── init.lua            ← Config class
 │   ├── appearance.lua      ← colors, GPU adapter, tab bar, window padding
 │   ├── bindings.lua        ← key/mouse bindings, key_tables, leader
 │   ├── domains.lua         ← wsl_domains / ssh_domains / unix_domains
 │   ├── fonts.lua           ← font, font_size (uses utils.platform)
 │   ├── general.lua         ← hyperlink_rules, scrollback, auto-reload
 │   └── launch.lua          ← default_prog + launch_menu per-OS
 ├── events/                 ← modules exposing M.setup(opts) → register handlers
 │   ├── left-status.lua     ← left status bar (active key table)
 │   ├── right-status.lua    ← right status bar (date + battery)
 │   ├── tab-title.lua       ← format-tab-title + custom tab events
 │   ├── new-tab-button.lua  ← right-click on new-tab button
+│   ├── help.lua            ← help.show-pager / help.show-picker handlers
 │   └── startup.lua         ← gui-startup: spawns initial window
 ├── utils/                  ← shared helpers, all `require('utils.X')`
 │   ├── platform.lua        ← {os, is_win, is_linux, is_mac} via wezterm.target_triple
 │   ├── cells.lua           ← Cells class for wezterm.format() segments (workhorse)
 │   ├── opts-validator.lua  ← schema-validated event opts (used by right-status, tab-title)
 │   ├── gpu-adapter.lua     ← auto-pick WebGPU adapter per OS
 │   ├── math.lua            ← clamp, round
 │   ├── dump.lua            ← global __dump/__pdump
-│   └── help.lua            ← registers global _keys() (Russian descriptions)
+│   ├── help.lua            ← keybindings reference: Russian descriptions,
+│   │                         categories, render()/active_entries(), _G._keys
+│   └── default-bindings.lua← GENERATED stock wezterm bindings (see below)
 ├── colors/custom.lua       ← active color scheme (catppuccin-mocha variant)
 └── docs/                   ← reference: default-config.md, default-keys.md,
                               ahk.md (Windows quake-style AHK script),
                               tempNotes.md (scratchpad, not authoritative)
 ```
 
+## Keybindings help (F1)
+
+`utils/help.lua` builds one reference text out of **config bindings + stock
+wezterm bindings**, grouped into categories (Интерфейс, Окна и вкладки, Панели,
+Ввод и буфер обмена, Скролл и буфер, Поиск и выделение, Мышь, Клавиатурные
+таблицы). `*` = from config, `→` = stock binding overridden by config, `-` =
+stock binding (in the main table it is **inactive**, because
+`disable_default_key_bindings = true`; key tables and mouse bindings stay
+active).
+
+Two entry points, both wired as custom events in `events/help.lua`:
+
+- `help.show-pager` → **F1**. Writes the text to a temp file and opens a new
+  tab with a pager: `less -R -X -F` on Linux/macOS, PowerShell
+  `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8` on Windows.
+- `help.show-picker` → **LEADER + ?** (`CTRL+Space`, then `?`). Fuzzy
+  `InputSelector` over *active* bindings; ENTER copies the chord to the
+  clipboard and shows a toast.
+
+`F12 → _keys()` prints the same text inside the debug overlay.
+
+Both handlers render from `window:effective_config()`, so `set_config_overrides`
+changes are reflected. The text is also rendered to a temp file at config load
+(`events/help.lua` → `M.setup`), because writing files from inside an event
+handler is not guaranteed in wezterm's Lua runtime — the handler re-writes the
+file if it can and falls back to the pre-generated one.
+
 ## Hidden coupling — easy to miss
 
 - **`config/domains.lua` is NOT in `wezterm.lua`'s append chain** (see the
   commented-out block at the bottom of `wezterm.lua`). But
   `events/new-tab-button.lua` requires it for `wsl_domains`/`ssh_domains`/
   `unix_domains` to populate the right-click launcher menu. Do **not** delete

@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Справка по горячим клавишам: два способа вызова из самого wezterm.
+--
+--   F1           → событие help.show-pager  — полный список в новой вкладке
+--                   (Linux/macOS: less, Windows: PowerShell Get-Content)
+--   LEADER + ?   → событие help.show-picker — fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям,
+--                   ENTER копирует сочетание в буфер обмена
+--
+-- Обработчики читают window:effective_config(), поэтому в списке видны и
+-- переопределения, сделанные через window:set_config_overrides().
+--
+-- Текст справки пишется во временный файл уже при загрузке конфига (в wezterm
+-- запись в файл внутри обработчика события может быть недоступна), а в
+-- обработчике файл обновляется по возможности.
+--
+-- Биндинги на эти события живут в config/bindings.lua (раздел misc/useful и
+-- key-tables), обработчики — здесь.
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+local wezterm = require('wezterm')
+local act = wezterm.action
+local platform = require('utils.platform')
+local help = require('utils.help')
+
+local M = {}
+
+local nf = wezterm.nerdfonts
+
+---Файл справки, созданный при загрузке конфига (запасной вариант)
+---@type string|nil
+local cached_path = nil
+
+---Команда для показа файла: less на unix, PowerShell Get-Content на Windows
+---@param path string
+---@return string program, string[] args
+local function pager_command(path)
+    if platform.is_win then
+        return 'powershell.exe',
+            {
+                '-NoProfile',
+                '-Command',
+                string.format('Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "%s"', path),
+            }
+    end
+    return 'less', { '-R', '-X', '-F', path }
+end
+
+---Записать справку в новый временный файл
+---@param text string
+---@return string|nil path
+local function write_help_file(text)
+    local got_path, path = pcall(os.tmpname)
+    if not got_path or type(path) ~= 'string' then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local ok, file = pcall(io.open, path, 'w')
+    if not ok or file == nil then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local written = pcall(function()
+        file:write(text)
+        file:flush()
+    end)
+    pcall(function()
+        file:close()
+    end)
+    if not written then
+        return nil
+    end
+    return path
+end
+
+---Данные текущего окна (с учётом set_config_overrides)
+---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
+---@return Help.Opts
+local function effective_opts(window)
+    local ok, config = pcall(function()
+        return window:effective_config()
+    end)
+    if not ok or type(config) ~= 'table' then
+        return {}
+    end
+    return {
+        keys = config.keys,
+        key_tables = config.key_tables,
+        mouse_bindings = config.mouse_bindings,
+        leader = config.leader,
+        defaults_disabled = config.disable_default_key_bindings,
+        from_effective = true,
+    }
+end
+
+---Справочный файл для показа: пробуем перезаписать его под текущее окно,
+---иначе отдаём тот, что создан при загрузке конфига
+---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
+---@return string|nil path, string|nil error
+local function help_file(window)
+    local ok, text = pcall(help.render, effective_opts(window))
+    if ok then
+        local written = write_help_file(text)
+        if written ~= nil then
+            return written
+        end
+    end
+    return cached_path, not ok and tostring(text) or nil
+end
+
+---Показать справку в отдельной вкладке с пайпером
+---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
+---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
+local function show_pager(window, pane)
+    local path, err = help_file(window)
+    if path == nil then
+        window:toast_notification(
+            'WezTerm',
+            'Не удалось подготовить справку: ' .. tostring(err),
+            nil,
+            4000
+        )
+        return
+    end
+
+    local program, args = pager_command(path)
+    window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab({ program = program, args = args }), pane)
+end
+
+---Fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям + копирование в буфер обмена
+---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
+---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
+local function show_picker(window, pane)
+    local ok, entries = pcall(help.active_entries, effective_opts(window))
+    if not ok or #entries == 0 then
+        window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Список сочетаний недоступен', nil, 3000)
+        return
+    end
+

+                end

+                    nil,
+                    1500
+                )
+            end),
+        }),
+        pane
+    )

+        )
+    end

+    wezterm.on('help.show-pager', show_pager)
+    wezterm.on('help.show-picker', show_picker)
+end

+return M

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Мелкие помощники
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+---@param str string
+---@param count number
+---@return string
+local function srep(str, count)
+    local result = ''
+    for _ = 1, count do
+        result = result .. str
+    end
+    return result
+end
+
+---@param str string
+---@param count number
+---@param symbol string
+---@return string
+local function cpad(str, count, symbol)
+    local l = #str
+    if l >= count or #symbol ~= 1 then
+        return str
+    end
+    local left = math.floor((count - l) / 2)
+    return srep(symbol, left) .. str .. srep(symbol, count - l - left)
+end
+
+---Дополнить строку пробелами до width (Lua 5.1 не умеет %-*s)
+---@param str string
+---@param width number
+---@return string
+local function pad_right(str, width)
+    local diff = width - #str
+    if diff <= 0 then
+        return str
+    end
+    return str .. srep(' ', diff)
+end

+-- Нормализация клавиш и модификаторов
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+local MOD_ORDER = { 'CTRL', 'SHIFT', 'ALT', 'SUPER', 'LEADER' }
+
+---Привести модификаторы к каноническому виду (SUPER→ALT на Linux/Windows)
+---@param mods string|nil
+---@return string через |
+local function normalize_mods(mods)
+    if type(mods) ~= 'string' or mods == '' or mods == 'NONE' then
+        return ''
+    end
+    local seen = {}
+    for token in mods:gmatch('[^|]+') do
+        local t = token:upper()
+        if t == 'SUPER' or t == 'CMD' or t == 'WIN' then
+            t = platform.is_mac and 'SUPER' or 'ALT'
+        elseif t == 'OPT' or t == 'META' then
+            t = 'ALT'
+        end
+        seen[t] = true
+    end
+    local out, rest = {}, {}
+    for _, token in ipairs(MOD_ORDER) do
+        if seen[token] then
+            table.insert(out, token)
+            seen[token] = nil
+        end
+    end
+    for token in pairs(seen) do
+        table.insert(rest, token)
+    end
+    table.sort(rest)
+    for _, token in ipairs(rest) do
+        table.insert(out, token)
+    end
+    return table.concat(out, '|')
+end
+
+---@param mods string нормализованные, через |
+---@return string[]
+local function mods_list(mods)
+    local out = {}
+    if mods == '' then
+        return out
+    end
+    for token in mods:gmatch('[^|]+') do
+        table.insert(out, token)
+    end
+    return out
+end

Hmm, complexity. Let me simplify the architecture:

`utils/help.lua`:
- `M.render(opts)`:
  - opts.keys, opts.key_tables, opts.mouse_bindings, opts.leader, opts.defaults_disabled (optional overrides)
  - defaults: `local b = require('config.bindings')`; keys = opts.keys or b.keys; etc.
  - default key list: `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` if available else {} (then render note)
  - default key_tables: `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()`
  - mouse: opts.mouse_bindings or (b.mouse_bindings + DEFAULT_MOUSE_BINDINGS)
- Also `M.build_entries(opts)` → structured list (for picker + render reuse).

`events/help.lua`:
- registers `help.show-pager`, `help.show-picker`
- helper `effective(window)`: builds opts from `window:effective_config()` — keys, key_tables, mouse_bindings, leader, disable_default_key_bindings; wraps in pcall, falls back to nil (→ static).

Careful: `window:effective_config()` returns keys where config's `disable_default_key_bindings=true` → keys only from config; and key_tables merged (copy_mode etc. shown in show-keys, so effective config includes default key tables merged with config's). Since show-keys showed copy_mode in effective output, effective_config().key_tables includes defaults. In that case my "default tables + config tables" merge would double-count — no: I merge defaults from `wezterm.gui.default_key_tables()` with config's; if effective already has them merged, I should prefer effective and not merge again. So logic: if effective provided → use it as the "active" set, and merge with `wezterm.gui.default_keys()` (main table only) to show inactive defaults. For key tables: if effective provided, treat effective tables as active; also include default tables that are NOT in effective (none). Simplest consistent rule:

- active_keys = effective keys or config keys
- active_tables = effective key_tables or config key_tables
- default_keys = wezterm.gui.default_keys() (always) — the ones not overridden by active → shown as "disabled standard"
- default_tables = wezterm.gui.default_key_tables() — tables names not in active_tables → shown as disabled standard (usually none)
- mouse: active = effective mouse_bindings (merged w/ defaults by wezterm) or config + curated defaults; mark custom ones by matching against the curated list.

Detecting "custom vs default" for mouse when using effective: compare against curated defaults by (mods, event) signature → those present in curated list are standard (and note config's override). Good enough; mark with `*` if signature differs from any curated default row.

Simplify: for mouse, classify each entry: custom if its (mods, event) signature is NOT in the curated default signature set. Then mark `→` if signature matches a curated default but the action differs.

Same logic applies to keys: signature = normalized mods + '|' + key. Compare with defaults. For keys: if signature in defaults → mark standard; if the action string differs from default's → mark `→` (перекрыто).

Actually classify active entries:
- `override`: signature exists in defaults AND action differs → '*' + '→'
- `config`: signature not in defaults → '*'
Inactive: defaults whose signature is not active → '-' (disabled).

```lua
local function action_name(action)
```

```lua
local function describe_action(action)
   local name = action_name(action)
   if name == 'Callback' then return 'Lua-обработчик из конфига (wezterm.action_callback)' end
   local d = ACTION_DESCRIPTIONS[name]
   if d == nil or d.describe == nil then return name end
   local ok, res = pcall(d.describe, { action = action })
   if not ok then return name end
   return res or name
end
```

```lua
local MOD_ORDER = { 'CTRL', 'SHIFT', 'ALT', 'LEADER' }
local function normalize_mods(mods)
   if mods == nil or mods == '' then return '' end
   local map = {}
   for token in mods:gmatch('[^|]+') do
      local t = token:upper()
      if t == 'SUPER' or t == 'CMD' or t == 'WIN' then t = platform.is_mac and 'SUPER' or 'ALT' end
      if t == 'OPT' or t == 'META' then t = 'ALT' end
      map[t] = true
   end
   local out = {}

   -- unknown tokens appended

      local known = false
      for _, k in ipairs(MOD_ORDER) do if k == t then known = true end end
      if not known then table.insert(out, t) end
   end
   table.sort(out) -- stability for leftovers
   return table.concat(out, '|')
end
```

```lua
M.setup = function()
   wezterm.on('help.show-pager', function(window, pane)
      local text = help.render(effective_opts(window))
      local path = write_help_file(text)
      if path == nil then
         window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Не удалось создать файл справки', nil, 3000)
         pane:send_text(text)
         return
      end
      local program, args = pager_command(path)
      window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab({ program = program, args = args }), pane)
   end)
   wezterm.on('help.show-picker', function(window, pane) ... end)
end
```

```lua
local function write_help_file(text)
   local path = os.tmpname()
   local f = io.open(path, 'w')
   if f == nil then return nil end
   f:write(text)
   f:close()
   return path
end
```

Actually in Lua, a local function declared after the closure body: the closure body refers to `describe_copy_mode` — at the point where the closure is created, the name isn't a local yet, so it resolves as a global (nil). parts.text: Теперь модуль событий с двумя способами показа:

input.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Справка по горячим клавишам: два способа вызова из самого wezterm.
--
--   F1           → событие help.show-pager  — полный список в новой вкладке
--                   (Linux/macOS: less, Windows: PowerShell Get-Content)
--   LEADER + ?   → событие help.show-picker — fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям,
--                   ENTER копирует сочетание в буфер обмена
--
-- Обработчики читают window:effective_config(), поэтому в списке видны и
-- переопределения, сделанные через window:set_config_overrides().
--
-- Биндинги на эти события живут в config/bindings.lua (см. раздел misc/useful).
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local wezterm = require('wezterm')
local act = wezterm.action
local platform = require('utils.platform')
local help = require('utils.help')

local M = {}

local nf = wezterm.nerdfonts

---Команда для показа файла: less на unix, PowerShell Get-Content на Windows
---@param path string
---@return string program, string[] args
local function pager_command(path)
   if platform.is_win then
      return 'powershell.exe', {
         '-NoProfile',
         '-Command',
         string.format('Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "%s"', path),
      }
   end
   return 'less', { '-R', '-X', '-F', path }
end

---Записать справку во временный файл
---@param text string
---@return string|nil path
local function write_help_file(text)
   local path = os.tmpname()
   local file = io.open(path, 'w')
   if file == nil then
      return nil
   end
   file:write(text)
   file:close()
   return path
end

---Данные текущего окна (с учётом set_config_overrides)
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@return Help.Opts
local function effective_opts(window)
   local ok, config = pcall(function()
      return window:effective_config()
   end)
   if not ok or type(config) ~= 'table' then
      return {}
   end
   return {
      keys = config.keys,
      key_tables = config.key_tables,
      mouse_bindings = config.mouse_bindings,
      leader = config.leader,
      defaults_disabled = config.disable_default_key_bindings,
      from_effective = true,
   }
end

---Показать справку в отдельной вкладке с пайпером
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
local function show_pager(window, pane)
   local text = help.render(effective_opts(window))
   local path = write_help_file(text)
   if path == nil then
      window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Не удалось создать файл справки', nil, 3000)
      if pane ~= nil then
         pane:send_text(text)
      end
      return
   end

   local program, args = pager_command(path)
   window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab({ program = program, args = args }), pane)
end

---Fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям + копирование в буфер обмена
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
local function show_picker(window, pane)
   local entries = help.active_entries(effective_opts(window))
   if #entries == 0 then
      window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Список сочетаний пуст', nil, 3000)
      return
   end

   local chords, choices = {}, {}
   for idx, entry in ipairs(entries) do
      chords[idx] = entry.chord
      choices[idx] = {
         id = tostring(idx),
         label = string.format('%-24s  %s', entry.chord, entry.description),
         description = entry.category,
      }
   end

   window:perform_action(
      act.InputSelector({
         title = string.format('%s Справка: горячие клавиши', nf.md_lightbulb),
         description = 'ENTER — скопировать сочетание в буфер обмена',
         fuzzy = true,
         fuzzy_description = 'Поиск сочетания: ',
         choices = choices,
         action = wezterm.action_callback(function(_window, _pane, id)
            if id == nil then
               return
            end
            local chord = chords[tonumber(id)]
            if chord == nil then
               return
            end
            local ok = pcall(function()
               wezterm.clipboard.set(chord)
            end)
            window:toast_notification(
               'WezTerm',
               ok and string.format('%s — скопировано', chord) or string.format('%s (буфер недоступен)', chord),
               nil,
               1500
            )
         end),
      }),
      pane
   )
end

M.setup = function()
   wezterm.on('help.show-pager', show_pager)
   wezterm.on('help.show-picker', show_picker)
end

return M

parts.text:
Two findings:
1. wezterm's Lua `string.format` doesn't support `%-*s` (LuaJIT-ish limitation? Actually Lua 5.1's string.format doesn't support `*`). Fix: compute padding manually.
2. Need to see probe for version etc. — the probe file got written but the render failed first... the probe shows render ok: false, then err. But the version lines should follow. They didn't print? The output shows only two lines. Because after the pcall, `probe:write('wezterm.version: '...)` — hmm, output truncated? Let me look: cat showed only 2 lines. Odd. Maybe the file was written but buffered and process exited? wezterm's config loader may exit before flush. Actually `probe:close()` is called. Hmm, but wezterm may `os.exit` right after config load... it should still have closed the file. Let me re-run and check the whole file. Maybe writing version failed because `wezterm.version` is nil → tostring(nil) fine. Let me just re-run and cat again.

First fix the format issue: replace `string.format(' %s %-*s  %s', ...)` with manual padding:

```lua
local function pad_right(str, width)
   local diff = width - #str
   if diff <= 0 then return str end
   return str .. string.rep(' ', diff)
end
```
Then `string.format(' %s %s  %s', marker, pad_right(entry.label, width), entry.description)`.

Note: `#str` on UTF-8 counts bytes; labels with (физ.) are ASCII except... key labels are ASCII. Descriptions are UTF-8 but they're last. Fine.

Let me apply thefix.

-- Генератор utils/default-bindings.lua из вывода `wezterm show-keys --lua`
package.path = '/tmp/opencode/?.lua;' .. package.path

local act_mt = {
    __index = function(_, name)
        return function(value)
            if value == nil then
                return { [name] = '' }
            end

Almost. Issue: `act.ToggleFullScreen` referenced without a call → my stub's `__index` returns a function, and the value is the *function itself* (not called). I need the value to be a callable table: use a table with `__call` so both `act.X` and `act.X(...)` work.

Let me fix the stub:
```lua
local function ctor(name)
   local t = {}
   setmetatable(t, { __call = function(_, value)
      if value == nil then return { [name] = '' } end
      return { [name] = value }
   end })
   return t
end
```
Then `act.ResetFontSize` → table t (no __index entries → `next(t)` = nil → 'Unknown'). Hmm, my serializer would emit `''` for an empty table. I need `action = { 'ToggleFullScreen' = '' }`.

Better: make the stub return a table that already looks like the action AND is callable:
```lua
local function ctor(name)
   local t = { [name] = '' }
   setmetatable(t, { __call = function(_, value)
      if value == nil then return t end
      return { [name] = value }
   end })
   return t
end
```
Then `act.ResetFontSize` → `{ResetFontSize=''}`; `act.ActivateTab(1)` → `{ActivateTab=1}`.

Also the indentation is ugly (nested tables). Let me improve the serializer to put simple single-key actions on one line:
`action = { 'ActivateTabRelative' = 1 },`
and multi-key/nested on separate lines. Simpler rule: if the action table has exactly 1 key whose value is a scalar → single line. Otherwise multi-line.

Also stylua will reformat anyway; I'll run stylua on the generated file (it's in the repo → stylua formats it to house style). Since I'll place it in the repo, run `stylua` on it.

Let me regenerate with the fixed stub and simpler serialization, then write it into the repo as `utils/default-bindings.lua`.

Also: `mods = 'NONE'` for key table rows: keep as is (help.lua handles 'NONE').

One more: the generated file has entries with `key = 'Copy'` (no mods) for the Copy/Paste special bindings — those have no mods field? In show-keys --lua: `{ key = 'Copy', action = act.CopyTo 'Clipboard' }` maybe without mods. My serializer emits mods = 'NONE' when nil. Fine.

Let me regenerate.

Fix: for table keys use `[ 'Name' ] = value` (valid for strings). Simpler: emit `[ 'X' ] = v`. For the flat single-line action: `{ [ 'ActivateTabRelative' ] = 1 }`.

-- стандартные сочетания wezterm
    local inactive = {}
    do
        for _, binding in ipairs(DEFAULTS.keys or {}) do
            local mods = normalize_mods(binding.mods)
            local base, prefix = split_key(binding.key)
            local signature = mods .. '|' .. base
            local current = active_signatures[signature]
            local key_part = key_label(base, prefix)
            local label_mods = table.concat(mods_list(mods), '+')
            local label = label_mods == '' and key_part or string.format('%s+%s', label_mods, key_part)
            if current == nil then
                table.insert(inactive, {
                    category = category_of(binding),
                    label = label,
                    chord = label,
                    description = describe_action(binding),
                    source = 'default',
                    active = false,
                    origin = 'standard',
                    signature = signature,
                })
            elseif current ~= action_signature(binding.action) then
                for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                    if entry.signature == signature then
                        entry.origin = 'override'
                        entry.description = string.format(
                            '%s  [перекрыто, было: %s]',
                            entry.description,
                            describe_action(binding)
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- мышиные привязки
    local default_mouse = {}
    for _, binding in ipairs(MOUSE_DEFAULTS) do
        default_mouse[mouse_signature(binding)] = action_signature(binding.action)
    end
    local from_effective = opts.mouse_bindings ~= nil
    local mouse_source = from_effective and active_mouse or list_extend(MOUSE_DEFAULTS, active_mouse)
    for _, binding in ipairs(mouse_source) do
        local signature = mouse_signature(binding)
        local label = event_label(normalize_mods(binding.mods), binding.event)
        local is_default = default_mouse[signature] ~= nil
        table.insert(entries, {
            category = 'Мышь',
            label = label,
            chord = label,
            description = describe_action(binding),
            source = is_default and 'default' or 'config',
            active = true,
            origin = is_default and (from_effective and 'standard' or 'override') or 'custom',
            signature = signature,
        })
    end

    -- клавиатурные таблицы
    local tables = {}
    for name, rows in pairs(active_tables) do
        tables[name] = { source = 'config', rows = rows }
    end
    local def_tables = DEFAULTS.key_tables or {}
    do
        for name, rows in pairs(def_tables) do
            if tables[name] == nil then
                tables[name] = { source = 'default', rows = rows }
            end
        end
    end

    local table_names = {}
    for name in pairs(tables) do
        table.insert(table_names, name)
    end
    table.sort(table_names)

    for _, name in ipairs(table_names) do
        local info = tables[name]
        for _, row in ipairs(info.rows) do
            push_key(row, row.mods or 'NONE', row.key, info.source, name .. '|' .. tostring(row.key), name)
        end
    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(inactive) do
        table.insert(entries, entry)
    end

Excellent, keys render correctly now. Remaining fixes:

1. Line 4: `создано: Time(utc: ...)` — fix `format_time` to use methods (`value:year()`) or `wezterm.time.now()` formatting. Let me check what fields the Time object exposes: my probe earlier printed `time.year type=...` but never got output. Let me test in a reliable harness now (run-help style with os.exit).

2. Line 3: `конфиг: /tmp/opencode/run-help.lua` — correct (test config). In real use it'll be the actual path.

3. Line 19/22: `ALT+-` / `ALT+=` → 'событие [user-defined-1]' — these are the action_callback resize bindings. Should say something friendlier: for `Callback` the description should be 'обработчик из конфига'. But here the action table has `EmitEvent = 'user-defined-1'` because wezterm resolved the callback into an EmitEvent action. Better: in `EmitEvent` describe, add a fallback for `user-defined-N` → 'обработчик из конфига (wezterm.action_callback)'. Let me add that.

4. Duplicates like `- CTRL+SHIFT+P` vs `* CTRL+SHIFT+p` — the config uses `phys:p` (lowercase 'p' because config writes `key = 'phys:p'`) and defaults have `phys:P`. Signature matching is case-sensitive → not detected as an override. Fix: uppercase single-letter keys in the signature comparison. Then `* CTRL+SHIFT+p` would become `→` with description "перекрыто, было: Командная панель" — hmm, that's semantically the same action but different case; better to keep them merged and NOT flag as override when the action matches. With case-insensitive signatures, the default's action == config's action (ActivateCommandPalette vs ActivateCommandPalette) → `current == action_signature(default)` → no override, and the default row disappears (merged). 

Let me implement: signature uses `key:upper()` for single-letter keys (keys of length 1). Actually wezterm treats letters case-insensitively unless SHIFT... hmm, 'p' vs 'P' with SHIFT means different (uppercase). But wezterm's own defaults list both `CTRL+SHIFT+P` and `CTRL+SHIFT+p`?? Looking at the earlier show-keys output: `SHIFT | CTRL C -> CopyTo` and `SHIFT | CTRL c -> CopyTo` — both exist! So case does matter in wezterm's key table (mapped keys). Ugh: uppercase vs lowercase = different keycodes.

For our purposes: matching config vs defaults should use the exact key (case-sensitive) — that keeps the current behavior (both rows shown). But it produces near-duplicate lines (CTRL+SHIFT+p vs CTRL+SHIFT+P). Hmm, is that confusing? Slightly, but it's accurate: config binds phys:P, defaults bind phys:p.

Actually wait: the config writes `key = 'phys:p'` with mods SHIFT|CTRL → wezterm treats as physical P. The default is `phys:p`? The show-keys output showed `SHIFT | CTRL P` and `SHIFT | CTRL p` — both physical? WezTerm's show-keys prints the *mapped* key. The default lua output has both 'P' and 'p' entries with mods SHIFT|CTRL. So the config's phys:p matches one of them exactly ('p' + SHIFT|CTRL) → they SHOULD have matched! But then why is `- CTRL+SHIFT+p` still listed as inactive?

Because the config entry key is `phys:p` → split_key gives base='p', mods normalized 'CTRL|SHIFT' → signature 'CTRL|SHIFT|p'. The default entry (from show-keys --lua) is `key = 'p'`? Let me check the generated data: does it contain `{ key = 'p', mods = 'SHIFT|CTRL', ...}`? If the default lua output has key='p' with mods='SHIFT|CTRL' then normalize → 'CTRL|SHIFT' + 'p' → same signature → should have matched and been marked override (or merged if the action is the same).

Line 36 shows `- CTRL+SHIFT+p  Отладочный оверлей` — that's key='l'?? No: line 35 `- CTRL+SHIFT+L`, line 36 `- CTRL+SHIFT+l`. So both L and l exist in the data. And line 27 `* CTRL+SHIFT+p` (config) vs... is there a `- CTRL+SHIFT+p` for ActivateCommandPalette? Line 36 is 'l' (debug overlay). Hmm, and line 34 `- CTRL+P` = ActivateCommandPalette (mods CTRL only). So the default `SHIFT|CTRL p` → maybe it IS matched (not in the inactive list) → meaning it was treated as an override... but line 27 shows `*` not `→`.

Confusing. Let me look at the generated defaults for 'p'/'P' entries to understand.

Actually line 27 `* CTRL+SHIFT+p  Командная панель` — the marker is '*' meaning origin='custom', so no default matched that signature, OR the default matched with the same action signature and thus wasn't added to inactive and no override flag. Both cases give '*'. Since `current == action_signature(default)` → neither branch: not added to inactive, no override → shows '*'. That's exactly the desired merge! 

So line 36 `- CTRL+SHIFT+l` — that's the default 'l' + SHIFT|CTRL (ShowDebugOverlay), and the config has phys:K/X/P/Space/T + SHIFT|CTRL but not 'l'/'L'. Correct.

And `- CTRL+SHIFT+L` is the default 'L' (mapped) — distinct from phys:l. Correct and accurate.

OK so no case-insensitivity needed. The rendering is accurate.

5. The 'Интерфейс' category shows F1/LEADER+? etc. — good.

Now let me fix:
(a) format_time
(b) user-defined-N description

Then check the rest of the output (categories, key tables, mouse, footer).

In show-keys --lua, AdjustPaneSize prints as `act.AdjustPaneSize{ 'Left', 1 }`? Let me check the generated data. 2. **`Search` description: "Поиск: false"** — the default action is `Search = 'CurrentSelectionOrEmptyString'` (a string), and my describe does `type(search) == 'table' and (...)` → for a string, needle = false (because `A and B` where A is false returns false). Fix: handle string values: 'CurrentSelectionOrEmptyString' → 'Поиск: выделение' etc.

3. **Mouse section: everything marked '→' (override) and raw action names** — because `from_effective` is false and `mouse_source = list_extend(MOUSE_DEFAULTS, active_mouse)` → the MOUSE_DEFAULTS rows get origin='override' (since is_default and not from_effective → 'override'). Bug in my logic: when building from the curated list, curated rows should be 'standard' (marker ' -'), and config rows that don't match any curated signature should be '*'. Only rows that match a curated signature but differ in action → '→'. Fix:
   - for each row: if signature in default_mouse: if action matches → source='default', origin='standard'; else → source='default', origin='override' (means config's version overrides the default).
   - else: source='config', origin='custom'.
   
   Also avoid listing duplicates: MOUSE_DEFAULTS + config rows → if config has the same signature as a default, we'd list both. Better: merge by signature — build a map from defaults, then apply config rows (overriding). Result: one row per signature.

   And descriptions: `SelectTextAtMouseCursor` with value 'Cell' → my describe returns the raw name because describe_action for `{SelectTextAtMouseCursor='Cell'}` uses action_name='SelectTextAtMouseCursor' which isn't in my descriptions table → returns name. Need descriptions for: SelectTextAtMouseCursor, ExtendSelectionToMouseCursor, CompleteSelection, CompleteSelectionOrOpenLinkAtMouseCursor, OpenLinkAtMouseCursor, StartWindowDrag (have), PasteFrom (have), ScrollByCurrentEventWheelDelta (have).

   Note: when the config's mouse bindings are in "effective" mode (real GUI), the actions are real wezterm tables — same shape. Good.

6. Line 167/168: "Скролл на 1.0 стр." vs config's "1.0 стр." — the [перекрыто, было: Скролл на 1 стр. вниз] is a false-positive override (config ScrollByPage(-1.0) vs default ScrollByPage(-1.0)? They differ only in description formatting: default action value is a float `NotNan(-1.0)` → in generated data probably `-1` (integer) vs config `-1.0` (float). Both print "1 стр." vs "1.0 стр." Hmm: config = -1.0 → my format prints '1.0'; default = -1 → '1'. So the action signature differs → flagged as override. It's a false positive in the sense the action is the same. Fix: normalize numbers in action_signature? Simpler: make the ScrollByPage description format consistent: use `%g`-ish formatting (strip trailing .0). `string.format('%s', 1.0)` → '1.0'. Use a helper `fmt_num(v)` that prints 1.0 as '1'. Then both produce identical descriptions → signature matches → no false override. 

   Also the earlier `ScrollByPage` describe has a weird leftover: `count > 0 and unit or unit` — I already simplified to 'стр.'; let me check the current code. I'll add number formatting.
