parts.text: Теперь надёжная запись файла справки (в т.ч. при отсутствии `wezterm.gui`):

input.content:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Справка по горячим клавишам: два способа вызова из самого wezterm.
--
--   F1           → событие help.show-pager  — полный список в новой вкладке
--                   (Linux/macOS: less, Windows: PowerShell Get-Content)
--   LEADER + ?   → событие help.show-picker — fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям,
--                   ENTER копирует сочетание в буфер обмена
--
-- Обработчики читают window:effective_config(), поэтому в списке видны и
-- переопределения, сделанные через window:set_config_overrides().
--
-- Текст справки пишется во временный файл уже при загрузке конфига (в wezterm
-- запись в файл внутри обработчика события может быть недоступна), а в
-- обработчике файл обновляется по возможности.
--
-- Биндинги на эти события живут в config/bindings.lua (раздел misc/useful и
-- key-tables), обработчики — здесь.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local wezterm = require('wezterm')
local act = wezterm.action
local platform = require('utils.platform')
local help = require('utils.help')

local M = {}

local nf = wezterm.nerdfonts

---Файл справки, созданный при загрузке конфига (запасной вариант)
---@type string|nil
local cached_path = nil

---Команда для показа файла: less на unix, PowerShell Get-Content на Windows
---@param path string
---@return string program, string[] args
local function pager_command(path)
    if platform.is_win then
        return 'powershell.exe',
            {
                '-NoProfile',
                '-Command',
                string.format('Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "%s"', path),
            }
    end
    return 'less', { '-R', '-X', '-F', path }
end

---Записать справку в новый временный файл
---@param text string
---@return string|nil path
local function write_help_file(text)
    local path = os.tmpname()
    local ok, file = pcall(io.open, path, 'w')
    if not ok or file == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local written = pcall(function()
        file:write(text)
        file:flush()
    end)
    pcall(function()
        file:close()
    end)
    if not written then
        return nil
    end
    return path
end

---Данные текущего окна (с учётом set_config_overrides)
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@return Help.Opts
local function effective_opts(window)
    local ok, config = pcall(function()
        return window:effective_config()
    end)
    if not ok or type(config) ~= 'table' then
        return {}
    end
    return {
        keys = config.keys,
        key_tables = config.key_tables,
        mouse_bindings = config.mouse_bindings,
        leader = config.leader,
        defaults_disabled = config.disable_default_key_bindings,
        from_effective = true,
    }
end

---Справочный файл для показа: пробуем перезаписать его под текущее окно,
---иначе отдаём тот, что создан при загрузке конфига
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@return string|nil path, string|nil error
local function help_file(window)
    local ok, text = pcall(help.render, effective_opts(window))
    if ok then
        local written = write_help_file(text)
        if written ~= nil then
            return written
        end
    end
    return cached_path, not ok and tostring(text) or nil
end

---Показать справку в отдельной вкладке с пайпером
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
local function show_pager(window, pane)
    local path, err = help_file(window)
    if path == nil then
        window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Не удалось подготовить справку: ' .. tostring(err), nil, 4000)
        return
    end

    local program, args = pager_command(path)
    window:perform_action(act.SpawnCommandInNewTab({ program = program, args = args }), pane)
end

---Fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям + копирование в буфер обмена
---@param window any wezterm.GuiWindow
---@param pane any wezterm.GuiPane|nil
local function show_picker(window, pane)
    local ok, entries = pcall(help.active_entries, effective_opts(window))
    if not ok or #entries == 0 then
        window:toast_notification('WezTerm', 'Список сочетаний недоступен', nil, 3000)
        return
    end

    local chords, choices = {}, {}
    for idx, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        chords[idx] = entry.chord
        choices[idx] = {
            id = tostring(idx),
            label = string.format('%-24s  %s', entry.chord, entry.description),
            description = entry.category,
        }
    end

    window:perform_action(
        act.InputSelector({
            title = string.format('%s Справка: горячие клавиши', nf.md_lightbulb),
            description = 'ENTER — скопировать сочетание в буфер обмена',
            fuzzy = true,
            fuzzy_description = 'Поиск сочетания: ',
            choices = choices,
            action = wezterm.action_callback(function(_window, _pane, id)
                if id == nil then
                    return
                end
                local chord = chords[tonumber(id)]
                if chord == nil then
                    return
                end
                local copied = pcall(function()
                    wezterm.clipboard.set(chord)
                end)
                window:toast_notification(
                    'WezTerm',
                    copied and string.format('%s — скопировано', chord) or string.format('%s (буфер недоступен)', chord),
                    nil,
                    1500
                )
            end),
        }),
        pane
    )
end

M.setup = function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        cached_path = write_help_file(help.render())
    end)
    if not ok or cached_path == nil then
        wezterm.log_error(string.format('help: не удалось создать файл справки: %s', tostring(err)))
    end

    wezterm.on('help.show-pager', show_pager)
    wezterm.on('help.show-picker', show_picker)
end

return M

1: # AGENTS.md
2: 
3: Personal wezterm configuration repo (Lua). Lives at `~/.config/wezterm/` and is
4: versioned as a git repo (`origin` → `git@github.com:lukashevich-t/wezterm-config.git`).
5: 
6: ## Architecture
7: 
8: `wezterm.lua` is the **only** entry point wezterm auto-discovers. It:
9: 
10: 1. Builds a `Config` object via `config/init.lua` (small OO wrapper with `init()` + `append(tbl)` that dedupes keys with a `wezterm.log_warn`).
11: 2. Calls `setup()` on every event module under `events/`.
12: 3. Returns the merged options table built by `:append(require('config.*'))`.
13: 
14: ```
15: wezterm.lua                 ← entrypoint
16: ├── config/                 ← pure option tables returned by each file
17: │   ├── init.lua            ← Config class
18: │   ├── appearance.lua      ← colors, GPU adapter, tab bar, window padding
19: │   ├── bindings.lua        ← key/mouse bindings, key_tables, leader
20: │   ├── domains.lua         ← wsl_domains / ssh_domains / unix_domains
21: │   ├── fonts.lua           ← font, font_size (uses utils.platform)
22: │   ├── general.lua         ← hyperlink_rules, scrollback, auto-reload
23: │   └── launch.lua          ← default_prog + launch_menu per-OS
24: ├── events/                 ← modules exposing M.setup(opts) → register handlers
25: │   ├── left-status.lua     ← left status bar (active key table)
26: │   ├── right-status.lua    ← right status bar (date + battery)
27: │   ├── tab-title.lua       ← format-tab-title + custom tab events
28: │   ├── new-tab-button.lua  ← right-click on new-tab button
29: │   └── startup.lua         ← gui-startup: spawns initial window
30: ├── utils/                  ← shared helpers, all `require('utils.X')`
31: │   ├── platform.lua        ← {os, is_win, is_linux, is_mac} via wezterm.target_triple
32: │   ├── cells.lua           ← Cells class for wezterm.format() segments (workhorse)
33: │   ├── opts-validator.lua  ← schema-validated event opts (used by right-status, tab-title)
34: │   ├── gpu-adapter.lua     ← auto-pick WebGPU adapter per OS
35: │   ├── math.lua            ← clamp, round
36: │   ├── dump.lua            ← global __dump/__pdump
37: │   └── help.lua            ← registers global _keys() (Russian descriptions)
38: ├── colors/custom.lua       ← active color scheme (catppuccin-mocha variant)
39: └── docs/                   ← reference: default-config.md, default-keys.md,
40:                               ahk.md (Windows quake-style AHK script),
41:                               tempNotes.md (scratchpad, not authoritative)
42: ```
43: 
44: ## Hidden coupling — easy to miss
45: 
46: - **`config/domains.lua` is NOT in `wezterm.lua`'s append chain** (see the
47:   commented-out block at the bottom of `wezterm.lua`). But
48:   `events/new-tab-button.lua` requires it for `wsl_domains`/`ssh_domains`/
49:   `unix_domains` to populate the right-click launcher menu. Do **not** delete
50:   it as "dead code".
51: - `events/tab-title.lua` defines three custom events consumed by
52:   `config/bindings.lua`: `tabs.manual-update-tab-title`, `tabs.reset-tab-title`,
53:   `tabs.toggle-tab-bar`. Key names must stay in sync with both files.
54: - `utils/help.lua` installs `_G._keys`; the F12 debug overlay is the only way
55:   to invoke it from the running terminal. Don't move it out of `utils/` without
56:   keeping the `require` in `wezterm.lua`.
57: 
58: ## Conventions to preserve
59: 
60: - **3-space indent, single quotes, `local M = {}` module pattern.**
61: - **`---@class` / `---@field` / `---@param` LuaCATS annotations everywhere** —
62:   they drive `lua-language-server` completions and are not noise. Keep them
63:   when editing.
64: - **Alignment-heavy tables** (key tables, color palettes) use a leading
65:   `-- stylua: ignore` marker. There is **no `stylua.toml`** in the repo;
66:   don't reformat those tables — they'll fight the markers.
67: - **`mod.SUPER` / `mod.SUPER_REV` in `config/bindings.lua`** map ALT/CTRL on
68:   Windows+Linux and SUPER/SUPER|CTRL on macOS (see top of that file). Use the
69:   table instead of hard-coding `ALT` or `SUPER` so cross-platform bindings
70:   stay consistent.
71: - **Platform branching** belongs in `utils/platform.lua` and (for OS-specific
72:   launch menu / default prog) in `config/launch.lua`. Do not re-detect the
73:   OS elsewhere.
74: 
75: ## Adding things
76: 
77: **New event module:** create `events/foo.lua` exposing `M.setup(opts)`, then
78: add `require('events.foo').setup(...)` to `wezterm.lua` alongside the other
79: event setups. Use `utils.cells` + `utils.opts-validator` to match the existing
80: pattern (`right-status.lua` is the cleanest reference).
81: 
82: **New config option:** add it to the relevant `config/*.lua` file. The
83: `Config:append` chain runs in order — duplicate keys are dropped with a
84: warning, so don't define the same key in two files.
85: 
86: **New color segment / status field:** build it via `Cells:new()` +
87: `add_segment` + `update_segment_text`/`update_segment_colors` + `render({ids})`,
88: then wrap in `wezterm.format(...)`. Nerd Font glyphs come from
89: `wezterm.nerdfonts` (e.g. `nf.ple_left_half_circle_thick`).
90: 
91: ## Verification
92: 
93: There are **no tests, no lint, no typecheck, no build step**. The only
94: verification is:
95: 
96: 1. `wezterm.lua` is reloaded automatically on save
97:    (`automatically_reload_config = true` in `config/general.lua`).
98: 2. On failure, wezterm surfaces the Lua error in a toast and logs to its log
99:    file (`wezterm log` or check the GUI window).
100: 3. Reload manually with `wezterm cli send-text --no-paste "key:ctrl+shift+R"`
101:    or via the `ReloadConfiguration` action if you bind it.
102: 
103: Use `_keys()` from inside the debug overlay (F12) to print a categorized list
104: of current bindings (labels are in Russian — see `utils/help.lua`).
105: 
106: ## Environment quirks
107: 
108: - **Font is hard-pinned** to `IosevkaTerm Nerd Font Mono` in `config/fonts.lua`.
109:   See `readme.md` for the download link. Many glyphs (semi-circles, battery,
110:   nerd icons) require this exact font — switching to a non-nerd variant will
111:   render them as `?`.
112: - `config/launch.lua` has hard-coded Windows paths (`d:/cygwin64/...`,
113:   `d:/msys64/...`) and `config/domains.lua` has a hard-coded WSL username
114:   (`kevin`). These are personal-environment artifacts — confirm with the user
115:   before "fixing" them.
116: - WSL image previews in `yazi` only work when launched via the SSH domain
117:   defined in `config/domains.lua` (commented in the file).
118: - The right-side date is driven by `update-right-status` on a 1 s cadence
119:   (`status_update_interval = 1000` in `config/general.lua`).
120: 
121: ## Git state
122: 
123: `main` tracks `origin/main`. There is currently **one uncommitted local edit**
124: in `events/right-status.lua` (un-commenting the `date_text` update so the
125: clock actually renders). Do not commit it without asking — it may be WIP.

(End of file - total 125 lines)
</content>

# AGENTS.md

Personal wezterm configuration repo (Lua). Lives at `~/.config/wezterm/` and is
versioned as a git repo (`origin` → `git@github.com:lukashevich-t/wezterm-config.git`).

## Architecture

`wezterm.lua` is the **only** entry point wezterm auto-discovers. It:

1. Builds a `Config` object via `config/init.lua` (small OO wrapper with `init()` + `append(tbl)` that dedupes keys with a `wezterm.log_warn`).
2. Calls `setup()` on every event module under `events/`.
3. Returns the merged options table built by `:append(require('config.*'))`.

```
wezterm.lua                 ← entrypoint
├── config/                 ← pure option tables returned by each file
│   ├── init.lua            ← Config class
│   ├── appearance.lua      ← colors, GPU adapter, tab bar, window padding
│   ├── bindings.lua        ← key/mouse bindings, key_tables, leader
│   ├── domains.lua         ← wsl_domains / ssh_domains / unix_domains
│   ├── fonts.lua           ← font, font_size (uses utils.platform)
│   ├── general.lua         ← hyperlink_rules, scrollback, auto-reload
│   └── launch.lua          ← default_prog + launch_menu per-OS
├── events/                 ← modules exposing M.setup(opts) → register handlers
│   ├── left-status.lua     ← left status bar (active key table)
│   ├── right-status.lua    ← right status bar (date + battery)
│   ├── tab-title.lua       ← format-tab-title + custom tab events
│   ├── new-tab-button.lua  ← right-click on new-tab button
│   ├── help.lua            ← help.show-pager / help.show-picker handlers
│   └── startup.lua         ← gui-startup: spawns initial window
├── utils/                  ← shared helpers, all `require('utils.X')`
│   ├── platform.lua        ← {os, is_win, is_linux, is_mac} via wezterm.target_triple
│   ├── cells.lua           ← Cells class for wezterm.format() segments (workhorse)
│   ├── opts-validator.lua  ← schema-validated event opts (used by right-status, tab-title)
│   ├── gpu-adapter.lua     ← auto-pick WebGPU adapter per OS
│   ├── math.lua            ← clamp, round
│   ├── dump.lua            ← global __dump/__pdump
│   ├── help.lua            ← keybindings reference: Russian descriptions,
│   │                         categories, render()/active_entries(), _G._keys
│   └── default-bindings.lua← GENERATED stock wezterm bindings (see below)
├── colors/custom.lua       ← active color scheme (catppuccin-mocha variant)
└── docs/                   ← reference: default-config.md, default-keys.md,
                              ahk.md (Windows quake-style AHK script),
                              tempNotes.md (scratchpad, not authoritative)
```

## Keybindings help (F1)

`utils/help.lua` builds one reference text out of **config bindings + stock
wezterm bindings**, grouped into categories (Интерфейс, Окна и вкладки, Панели,
Ввод и буфер обмена, Скролл и буфер, Поиск и выделение, Мышь, Клавиатурные
таблицы). `*` = from config, `→` = stock binding overridden by config, `-` =
stock binding (in the main table it is **inactive**, because
`disable_default_key_bindings = true`; key tables and mouse bindings stay
active).

Two entry points, both wired as custom events in `events/help.lua`:

- `help.show-pager` → **F1**. Writes the text to a temp file and opens a new
  tab with a pager: `less -R -X -F` on Linux/macOS, PowerShell
  `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8` on Windows.
- `help.show-picker` → **LEADER + ?** (`CTRL+Space`, then `?`). Fuzzy
  `InputSelector` over *active* bindings; ENTER copies the chord to the
  clipboard and shows a toast.

`F12 → _keys()` prints the same text inside the debug overlay.

Both handlers render from `window:effective_config()`, so `set_config_overrides`
changes are reflected. The text is also rendered to a temp file at config load
(`events/help.lua` → `M.setup`), because writing files from inside an event
handler is not guaranteed in wezterm's Lua runtime — the handler re-writes the
file if it can and falls back to the pre-generated one.

## Hidden coupling — easy to miss

- **`config/domains.lua` is NOT in `wezterm.lua`'s append chain** (see the
  commented-out block at the bottom of `wezterm.lua`). But
  `events/new-tab-button.lua` requires it for `wsl_domains`/`ssh_domains`/
  `unix_domains` to populate the right-click launcher menu. Do **not** delete
  it as "dead code".
- `events/tab-title.lua` defines three custom events consumed by
  `config/bindings.lua`: `tabs.manual-update-tab-title`, `tabs.reset-tab-title`,
  `tabs.toggle-tab-bar`. Key names must stay in sync with both files.
- `events/help.lua` defines `help.show-pager` and `help.show-picker`, consumed
  by `config/bindings.lua` (F1 and LEADER+?). Keep both sides in sync.
- **`utils/default-bindings.lua` is generated data, not hand-written.** It holds
  the stock wezterm bindings used by the help reference. Regenerate it after a
  wezterm upgrade (see "Environment quirks" for the exact commands), never edit
  it by hand — descriptions for stock actions live in `utils/help.lua`.
- `utils/help.lua` requires `config.bindings` **lazily, inside `M.entries()`** —
  that indirection is what keeps `config/bindings.lua` free of a require cycle
  with the help module.
- `utils/help.lua` installs `_G._keys`; the F12 debug overlay is a fallback way
  to invoke it (F1 is the normal one). Don't move it out of `utils/` without
  keeping the `require` in `wezterm.lua`.

## Conventions to preserve

- **4-space indent** (per `stylua.toml`), single quotes, `local M = {}` module
  pattern. Run `stylua` after editing; CI enforces it.
- **`---@class` / `---@field` / `---@param` LuaCATS annotations everywhere** —
  they drive `lua-language-server` completions and are not noise. Keep them
  when editing.
- **Alignment-heavy tables** (key tables, color palettes, `MOUSE_DEFAULTS` in
  `utils/help.lua`, `utils/default-bindings.lua` rows) use a leading
  `-- stylua: ignore` marker. Don't reformat those by hand — they'll fight the
  markers.
- **`mod.SUPER` / `mod.SUPER_REV` in `config/bindings.lua`** map ALT/CTRL on
  Windows+Linux and SUPER/SUPER|CTRL on macOS (see top of that file). Use the
  table instead of hard-coding `ALT` or `SUPER` so cross-platform bindings
  stay consistent.
- **Platform branching** belongs in `utils/platform.lua` and (for OS-specific
  launch menu / default prog / pager) in `config/launch.lua` and
  `events/help.lua`. Do not re-detect the OS elsewhere.

## Adding things

**New event module:** create `events/foo.lua` exposing `M.setup(opts)`, then
add `require('events.foo').setup(...)` to `wezterm.lua` alongside the other
event setups. Use `utils.cells` + `utils.opts-validator` to match the existing
pattern (`right-status.lua` is the cleanest reference).

**New config option:** add it to the relevant `config/*.lua` file. The
`Config:append` chain runs in order — duplicate keys are dropped with a
warning, so don't define the same key in two files.

**New key binding:** add it to `config/bindings.lua`. If it is a custom event,
declare the event in the owning `events/*.lua` file too. If you want a Russian
description in the F1 reference, add an entry to `action_descriptions` in
`utils/help.lua` (`groups` puts it into a category).

**New color segment / status field:** build it via `Cells:new()` +
`add_segment` + `update_segment_text`/`update_segment_colors` + `render({ids})`,
then wrap in `wezterm.format(...)`. Nerd Font glyphs come from
`wezterm.nerdfonts` (e.g. `nf.ple_left_half_circle_thick`).

## Verification

There are **no tests and no build step**, but there *is* linting (see
`.github/workflows/lint.yml`):

1. `stylua --check .` — formatting; must pass (it is currently the only thing
   failing, due to the known WIP in `events/right-status.lua`).
2. `luacheck .` — warnings/lint; should be 0 warnings.
3. `luac -p <file>` — quick syntax check for one file.
4. `wezterm --config-file ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua show-keys` — proves the
   whole config loads and shows the effective key table (works headless).
5. To preview the help output without the GUI:
   `wezterm --config-file /tmp/run-help.lua show-keys` where that temp config
   sets `package.path`, `require`s `utils.help`, writes `help.render()` to a
   file and calls `os.exit(0)`.

At runtime `wezterm.lua` reloads automatically on save
(`automatically_reload_config = true` in `config/general.lua`); on failure wezterm
shows the Lua error in a toast and writes it to its log file.

## Environment quirks

- **Font is hard-pinned** to `IosevkaTerm Nerd Font Mono` in `config/fonts.lua`.
  See `readme.md` for the download link. Many glyphs (semi-circles, battery,
  nerd icons) require this exact font — switching to a non-nerd variant will
  render them as `?`.
- `config/launch.lua` has hard-coded Windows paths (`d:/cygwin64/...`,
  `d:/msys64/...`) and `config/domains.lua` has a hard-coded WSL username
  (`kevin`). These are personal-environment artifacts — confirm with the user
  before "fixing" them.
- WSL image previews in `yazi` only work when launched via the SSH domain
  defined in `config/domains.lua` (commented in the file).
- The right-side date is driven by `update-right-status` on a 1 s cadence
  (`status_update_interval = 1000` in `config/general.lua`).
- **Regenerate `utils/default-bindings.lua` after upgrading wezterm:**
  ```sh
  wezterm --skip-config show-keys --lua > /tmp/dk-default.lua
  wezterm --skip-config show-keys --lua --key-table copy_mode  > /tmp/dk-copy.lua
  wezterm --skip-config show-keys --lua --key-table search_mode > /tmp/dk-search.lua
  ```
  (the generator lives in the commit history / ask the user; the `--lua` files
  are loaded with a stubbed `wezterm.action` and re-serialized as plain tables).
- **Lua 5.1 runtime**: `string.format` does **not** support `%-*s` (use
  `utils/help.lua`'s `pad_right`), and `goto`/integer division quirks apply.
  `wezterm.time.now()` and `wezterm.gui.*` are not safely callable while the
  config file itself is loading — hence the generated defaults table and
  `os.date` for timestamps.

## Git state

`main` tracks `origin/main`. There is currently **one uncommitted local edit**
in `events/right-status.lua` (un-commenting the `date_text` update so the
clock actually renders). Do not commit it without asking — it may be WIP.

**Справка по клавишам (вызывается из самого WezTerm)**
- **F1** → `help.show-pager`: полный список в новой вкладке — `less -R -X -F` на Linux/macOS, PowerShell `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8` на Windows (`events/help.lua:39`).
- **LEADER + ?** (`CTRL+Space`, затем `?`) → `help.show-picker`: fuzzy-поиск по активным сочетаниям, ENTER копирует сочетание в clipboard + тост.
- Текст рендерится из `config/bindings.lua` + `window:effective_config()`, сгруппирован по 8 категориям (Интерфейс, Окна и вкладки, Панели, Ввод и буфер обмена, Скролл и буфер, Поиск и выделение, Мышь, Клавиатурные таблицы). Легенда: `*` из конфига, `→` перекрыто конфигом, `-` стандартное wezterm (в основной таблице помечено как **неактивное**, т.к. `disable_default_key_bindings = true`; мышь и key tables остаются активными). 310 строк, все описания на русском, включая `copy_mode`/`search_mode`/`resize_*`.
- `F12 → _keys()` сохранён как фолбэк.

**Файлы**
- `utils/help.lua` — переписан: описания ~70 действий, нормализация модов под платформу, `phys:`-метки, мержинг мышиных привязок по сигнатуре.
- `utils/default-bindings.lua` (новый, **генерируемый**) — 136 стандартных сочетаний + 62 copy_mode + 10 search_mode, сняты с вашей версии через `wezterm show-keys --lua`. Команды регенерации описаны в AGENTS.md.
- `events/help.lua` (новый) — обработчики + предгенерация файла при загрузке конфига (запись файла из event-handler в wezterm не гарантирована, поэтому есть фолбэк).
- `config/bindings.lua:31,238` — две новые привязки; `wezterm.lua:13` — `require('events.help').setup()`.

**AGENTS.md исправлен**: 4-space индент вместо «3-space» (в репо есть `stylua.toml` с `indent_width = 4`), линты есть (CI `stylua --check .` + `luacheck .`, команды добавлены в раздел Verification), описаны новые модули/события, раздел про справку, регенерация `default-bindings.lua`, квирки Lua 5.1 (`%-*s` не поддерживается, `wezterm.time.now()`/`wezterm.gui.*` не вызываются при загрузке конфига).
